name: Custom Shader 2D
title: Custom Shader 2D
description: Apply a custom Metal fragment shader to 2D shapes. loadShader() reads the MSL file, shader() applies it so rect()/circle() become surfaces the shader runs on, and resetShader() goes back to the built-in shader. Built-in uniforms (resolution, mouse, time, frameCount) arrive at buffer(3); setParameters() sends your own struct to buffer(4).
